servinfo.title: Auxiliary Power Module (Lithium-Ion Battery) Control System Check

item.ptxt: Check DTC related to auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery).

topic.title: In case that current DTC is detected:
topic.ptxt: Perform troubleshoot with flow chart for applicable current DTC and detect the trouble area in sensor, actuator, wire harness, connector, auxiliary power module (lithium-ion battery), ECM, etc., and repair or replace faulty part.

topic.title: In case that history DTC is detected:

s1.ptxt: Record DTC and then clear DTC once.

Referring to “Circuit Diagram” and “Trouble Area” in applicable DTC troubleshooting, check related parts that are prone to cause intermittent trouble (e.g. wire harness, connector, etc.) for detected history DTC.

servinfosub.title: Step 2: Final Confirmation Test
servinfosub.ptxt: Check that the problem symptom does not recur and the vehicle is free from any abnormal conditions. If what has been repaired is related to DTC, clear DTC once, perform DTC confirmation procedure and check that no DTC is indicated.
